Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Sushant Modani and Saiteja Mukkamalla are the batters for the USA. Junaid Siddique to start with the new ball. Let's play...
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, United Arab Emirates have scored 308 runs and will be hoping for their bowlers to defend this. For the USA, the onus is now on their batters to put up a gritty stand and chase this down. Which side will come out on top? Let's find out soon. Chase coming up shortly...

Asif Khan is in for a chat. He says that he feels delighted with the score and this is for the skipper who has gone back because of a personal reason. Adds that he was struggling a bit in the past few games and this innings will help his confidence. Also adds that the coach has helped him a lot as he batted lower down the order a few times but being an opener this is the place that suits him the best.

The USA bowlers were under the pump from the word go. They failed to pick wickets and ended up with 308 runs for their batters to chase. Ali Khan was the pick of the bowlers for them as he chipped in with two wickets. Nosthush Kenjige and Saurabh Netravalkar picked one while the rest of the bowlers were wicketless.

Asif Khan, you beauty! What a knock this has been from him. He went on to score 151 runs and made his side reach a mammoth total of 308 runs. Electing to bat first, United Arab Emirates were off to a flying start and both the openers scored a half-century. the young Aryansh Sharma was dismissed on 57 but Asif Khan continued with the good work and went on to score a ton. Basil Hameed chipped in with a cameo of 44 runs in the end.

Full and wide outside off, Asif Khan slices this towards third man for a couple as the United Arab Emirates innings ends at 308 for the loss of 4 wickets in 50 overs. Asif Khan has carried his bat through the innings.

Commentary.Commentary: Right then, we are done with the pre-match proceedings. USA players move in the middle and take their respective fielding positions. Aryansh Sharma and Asif Khan are the batters for United Arab Emirates. Saurabh Netravalkar comes to ball. Here we go...

We are all set for the game to begin. The teams stride out in the middle and line up for their respective national anthems. It will be the United Arab Emirates first, followed by the national anthem of the USA.

Monank Patel the skipper of USA says they would have bowled first. Adds that they would want to play the best brand of cricket and would like to come good against the USA. Informs that they have got one change.

Vriitya Aravind the skipper of United Arab Emirates says they would like to bat first. Adds that the ball wasn't doing much early on and that the pitch remains same throughout the day. Adds that they would want to put a big score on board and defend it later. Informs that they have a couple of changes.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Asif Khan, Aryansh Sharma, Vriitya Aravind (C) (WK), Ethan D'souza, Rohan Mustafa, Basil Hameed, Ali Naseer, Aayan Khan, Sanchit Sharma, Junaid Siddique, Muhammad Jawadullah
USA (Playing XI) - Sushant Modani, Saiteja Mukkamalla, Monank Patel (C)(WK), Aaron Jones, Gajanand Singh, Shayan Jahangir, Nisarg Patel, Nosthush Kenjige, Jessy Singh, Ali Khan, Saurabh Netravalkar.
TOSS-: United Arab Emirates have won the coin flip and they have decided to BAT first.

United Arab Emirates have had a really bad campaign as a lot was expected of them coming into the tournament. They looked like the nation that would have challenged the full member nations as the batting for them was looking rock solid but the failures of skipper Muhammad Waseem and Keeper Vriitya Aravind have added to the vows of United Arab Emirates resulting in them losing every game so far. The winner takes the 9th spot here and let's see who wins the game with pride on stake. Stay tuned for toss and team updates...

The USA have had a really tough tour as they have had there issues with injuries and illness to the players that have resulted in them putting out a make-shift playing XI in all the games played so far. The batting has faltered and so has the bowling. This has been a campaign of learnings more than results for them and they would be wanting to end this campaign on a high with a victory today.
Hello and welcome to all our viewers. USA takes on the United Arab Emirates at the Takashinga Sports Club, Harare for the 9th-place playoff game.
...MATCH DAY...

Pride at stake for two nations trying to establish on the cricketing map of the world collide against each other as United Arab Emirates takes on the USA. It will be the last game played at this venue of Harare for the ICC World Cup Qualifiers. Both the USA and the United Arab Emirates have had a tournament to forget, but they will take a lot of learning from this tour as they faced some of the giants of the cricketing world. USA had problems with the fitness of the players as they were unable to field a full-strength side in any of the games due to some illness to one or the other player. While the United Arab Emirates, couldn't play as expected of them. The batting of the United Arab Emirates faltered so badly that they failed to score in excess of 250 in any of the games they have played so far in Zimbabwe. This game is all about pride and leaving Zimbabwe with some happy memories as the winner takes the ninth spot in the ICC Cricket World Cup qualifiers. The United Arab Emirates have a really strong side and they will be depending upon their batters to come up well, while the USA would love to perform collectively and leave Zimbabwe with happy memories. Let's see who wins the battle for the 9th spot.
